### Ticket Classification
Intent: Product Support
Urgency: low

### Organization Policy Documents
[DOC027] Email Campaign Deliverability and DNS Authentication (Digital Marketing)
Outbound marketing campaigns require verified SPF, DKIM, and DMARC DNS records on the sender domain before bulk dispatch is enabled. New sending domains undergo an automated 14-day warm-up schedule capping initial daily volume to protect sender reputation. Campaigns exceeding a 0.3 percent spam complaint threshold or 5 percent hard bounce rate are paused automatically pending list hygiene review.

[DOC011] Third-Party CRM and Helpdesk Connectors (Integrations)
Native bi-directional connectors are maintained for Salesforce, HubSpot, Zendesk, Jira, and Slack through the Integrations Marketplace. Incremental synchronization runs every 5 minutes, while manual full resyncs are throttled to once per hour to protect API quotas. When a connector reports an expired OAuth grant, re-authorizing with a service account preserves field mappings and historical sync state.

[DOC013] Application Latency Targets and Troubleshooting (Performance)
The platform targets a p95 web dashboard response time under 400 milliseconds and API read latency under 250 milliseconds under normal load. When troubleshooting slow client rendering, users should capture a browser HAR trace, disable conflicting extensions, and verify network latency to the regional edge node. Support engineers require a timestamp, workspace ID, and request correlation ID to inspect backend traces.

We can provide you with information on the integration features of PrestaShop and Shopware, including data synchronization and order management. We also offer documentation to assist you in getting started. Example 2 (Technical Support | high):

Please let us know a convenient time for the call at <tel_num>. During the call, we can review your campaigns on Discord, Spotify, and Shopware, and provide recommendations to optimize performance and meet your marketing objectives. We look forward to speaking with you soon and resolving the issues affecting your campaigns. Your account number is <acc_num>.

Example 3 (Technical Support | high):
Hello [Your Name], we appreciate your interest in exploring integrations for Shopware with Google Cloud Platform and Microsoft Azure services. We can offer you a comprehensive list of available integrations and their descriptions, including Google Cloud Storage, Google Cloud Functions, and Microsoft Azure Storage. I would like to arrange a call with you at [tel_num] to discuss your specific requirements in more detail and provide tailored guidance. Please let me know a convenient time for the call.

Our company aims to leverage the platform's capabilities to create seamless and engaging customer experiences. We believe that integrating Shopware with Spotify could enhance our marketing efforts and help us reach a broader audience. However, we are unsure of the best approach and would greatly appreciate any guidance or support you can provide. Could you please share information about available integration options, APIs, plugins, and the necessary steps to proceed?

<name>, thank you for contacting customer support regarding the integration of Shopware with Spotify for digital marketing campaigns. To assist you, I would like to discuss the available integration options, APIs, plugins, and the necessary steps to get started. I can also provide information on synchronizing your product catalog with Spotify's advertising platform and tracking campaign performance. If convenient, I would be happy to schedule a call at <tel_num> to discuss your questions in detail. Alternatively, please let us know how we can assist further.

[DOC022] Security Vulnerability Disclosure and Incident Reporting (Security and Compliance)
Suspected account compromises, phishing attempts, or unauthorized API access must be reported immediately as High-urgency Security incidents. Upon confirmation of unauthorized credential use, Support immediately revokes active sessions and rotates workspace API secrets. Responsible security researchers may submit reproducible reports via our encrypted PGP intake channel for a 24-hour triage acknowledgment.

[DOC023] SOC 2 Type II and Compliance Audit Documentation (Security and Compliance)
The platform maintains annual SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 certifications covering security, availability, and confidentiality trust principles. Current audit reports, penetration test executive summaries, and subprocessor lists are accessible under NDA from the Trust Portal. Standard compliance questionnaires are processed by our Security Assurance team within 5 business days.

[DOC016] Service Outage Communication and Status Updates (Outages and Maintenance)
During active service disruptions, incident commanders publish initial status updates on the public Status Page within 15 minutes of detection. Ongoing incidents receive structured progress updates every 30 minutes until full service restoration is confirmed. Enterprise customers receive automated email and webhook notifications and can request a formal Root Cause Analysis within 5 business days of resolution.

Plan upgrades and additional seat purchases take effect immediately with prorated charges calculated to the exact remaining days in the current billing cycle. Downgrades and seat reductions are scheduled to apply at the start of the next billing cycle so existing workflows are not interrupted mid-month. Annual plans may be adjusted upward at any time, while downward tier changes occur at renewal.

Standard payment terms are Net 15 from the invoice issue date unless an enterprise Net 30 agreement is active. Copies of past PDF invoices and itemized usage breakdowns are downloadable directly from the Billing Portal. Unpaid balances beyond 10 days past due trigger automated reminder notices prior to any temporary account restriction.

[DOC036] Refund Processing Timelines and Subscription Cancellations (Returns and Exchanges)
Refunds for returned physical goods are initiated within 3 business days after the warehouse confirms item condition. Card and bank refunds typically settle on customer statements within 5 to 10 business days depending on the issuing bank. Annual SaaS subscriptions are eligible for a full refund only within 14 days of initial purchase or renewal.
